description: DAYVIM crystallizes in the tetragonal crystal system with space group P -4 n 2. Reported CIF formula moiety: C88 H88 Cl2 Er4 N21 O31 Zn2 1+,4(C1 H4 O1),N1 O3 1-,H2 O1. From the CIF bond table, Er1 (Er) has 6 O neighbors; Zn1 (Zn) has 2 O neighbors; Er2 (Er) has 6 O neighbors; Zn2 (Zn) has 2 O neighbors; Er3 (Er) has 6 O neighbors; Er4 (Er) has 6 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 2 pairs, 4 components; largest component is a chain with insufficient metal sites for a 3D shape classification. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.538-3.538 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 93.64-98.76°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Zn2Er4(H2L)4(NO3)Cl2(H2O)]·NO3·xCH3OH·yH2O. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 1 NO3 (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 1 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
